text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower finished running the Nikkei 
Sho. Zenno Rob Roy, who had come to cheer 
her on, rushes over to her side.

Seeing Rice Shower forge ahead toward her 
goal, she praised her for being like the 
heroine of a story.

Though shy about the praise, Rice Shower 
was overjoyed that she felt closer to 
becoming a "blue rose."
